svg.title: Measured cell features and KRONOS image features feed the same classifier choices
svg.desc: Left: a cell and its compartments supply saved measurement columns; selected columns preserve the cell rows. Right: a nucleus-centred marker-image crop is masked, normalized and encoded by fixed KRONOS weights to 768 features per cell. A labelled subset from either feature matrix fits normalization, optional PCA and one selected classifier: random-forest trees, pairwise SVM boundaries or logistic class scores. The saved transformation and classifier predict features from target cells and retain cell IDs. All images, feature intensities, class boundaries and predictions are schematic.

g.text: Save the selected classifier + fitted preparation
